code_status: No author training/model release found in the paper links and targeted searches; unofficial repositories exist. Absence is a search finding, not a proof.
implementation_origin: Independent reconstruction of paper equations/text/figures. Reuses the existing MIT-attributed GenRec feature embedding adapter only. No external TokenMixer-Large code imported or vendored.

mapping.implementation: reshape (B,T,D) to (B,H,T*D/H), transpose; exact inverse restores (B,T,D); H=8 differs from T=16

mapping.ambiguity: Printed Eq 12/16 show Post-Norm. Follow Figure 1 and prose Pre-Norm explicitly; no claim of author numerical parity.

mapping.implementation: 15 deterministic balanced groups of anonymous Criteo fields plus a separate all-field global MLP; bias-free projections
mapping.adaptation: Criteo does not expose industrial semantic groups or sequence aggregators; balanced field-order grouping is a disclosed replacement.

mapping.implementation: isolated up/gate/down weights per token or mixed head; SiLU gate, no linear biases

E=4 partitions dense hidden nD into nD/E each; one shared expert always active, one of three routed experts selected (top_k=2 includes shared); selected rows alone reach routed FFNs; no load-balance loss

mapping.paper: v2 section 3.4.1 explicitly constrains selected gates to sum one
mapping.mathematical_consequence: With exactly one routed expert selected its normalized weight is one, yielding zero gate gradient. This is tested and reported, not patched by an undisclosed estimator. router_normalization=all is separately available as an explicit ablation.

mapping.implementation: Xavier uniform gain=0.01 on down matrices; up/gate gain=1
mapping.ambiguity: Appendix A.7 mentions Xavier normal and a variance-scale formula. Chosen standard-deviation gain follows section 3.4.4 and Table 14, not silent interchange of variance and stddev.

mapping.implementation: add an anchor every 2 blocks, reset anchor at each addition, exclude final block
auxiliary heads at intermediate residual boundaries; BCE of cumulatively summed shallow/deep logits, averaged and weighted 0.1; no stop-gradient
mapping.assumptions: Exact tower architecture, weight, detach semantics and aggregation not specified. Global-token linear heads, mean reduction and weight 0.1 are explicit choices.

mapping.implementation: Adagrad dense lr=.01, categorical embedding lr=.05; single-host synchronous public pilot
mapping.adaptation: Paper uses distributed asynchronous sparse updates on private streaming exposures; PyTorch Adagrad defaults are recorded rather than inferred as author values.

mapping.implementation: BF16 autocast, FP32 optimizer state; no FP8 serving/kernel/Token Parallel claim

public_experiment.dataset: same frozen Criteo_x1 train/valid/test and training-fitted vocab as the framework ranking track
public_experiment.regularization: embedding L2 coefficient 1e-5 and clip norm 10 inherited from the public CTR protocol; original paper values undisclosed

claim_boundary: Reduced public-data algorithm reconstruction, not a reproduction of private 500M-15B curves, distributed throughput, FP8 speedups or online business lift.
